title: MemoryReflectionsGenerateRequest
description: Explicit, cost-bearing generation (MEM-R012). Admission fails closed: missing required profile kinds → PROFILE_INCOMPLETE, insufficient data → INSUFFICIENT_DATA, stale expected_state_digest → REVISION_CONFLICT. Completion is publish-pinned: a moved basis still publishes with its pinned basis and immediately reads stale (MEM-R013). Grant: reflect covering the selection/filter. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen; unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
